description: Fix the to-do tray wrap loop syntax error in apps/openagents-desktop/page/todos.coax so page.coax compiles and passes tests.

steps.send: apps/openagents-desktop/page.coax stopped compiling because of a bad range syntax in apps/openagents-desktop/page/todos.coax (E0216). Fix the loop in cp_todos_tray so it reaches wn cleanly without reading past wb[wn], and verify with `coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-desktop/page.coax --only todos`.
